summary: V2.47.256 fixes the V2.47.255 Pending Inbox category picker interaction regression. The root cause was a capture-phase global scroll listener that treated the picker's own focus/list scrolling as a close signal, making the selector appear to freeze or become unclickable. The fix removes captured-scroll auto-close and focuses the search field with preventScroll while preserving outside-click and resize close behavior, canonical category order/hierarchy, explicit selection semantics, schema/data/auth/updater behavior and Owner-manual Production.
